description:
Auction algorithm for bipartite matching (Bertsekas):
- Bidding Phase: Unassigned tasks bid on resource minimizing cost + price, incrementing resource price by regret gap plus epsilon and displacing prior occupant.
- Epsilon Scaling: Decrease epsilon geometrically across successive auction phases.
- Fallback: Revert to LAPJV/shortest augmenting path if unmatched rows persist, matrix is non-square, or costs are ill-conditioned.
